name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Your first task is one of cleansing, adventurer.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
narrative.requestItemsText: How goes the hunting, adventurer? Have you found and defeated those vermin?
